title: Kombination und Erweiterung / light background
slide_intent: Keep combined graphics subordinate to one focus so a detailed composition remains readable.
strategic_value: A subdued skyline with one color accent can make DB destination imagery expressive without clutter.
demonstration: The light-background tab shows a gray combined skyline with one red tower under the composition guidance.
practical_value: Keep combined graphics at equal detail, use a subtle gray background treatment and highlight only one focal element in red or lilac.

content_islands.name: Combination rules
content_islands.spec: Place the detail, complexity and color conditions above the tabs.

content_islands.name: Combined skyline
content_islands.spec: Use gray landmarks as context around the single red focal tower.

reference_purposes.Application: The skyline demonstrates combined graphics with a single color focus.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Combined compositions are only subtle backgrounds in defined grays; one focal element may use DB Red or Transitional Lilac.
